name: systemfsoftware
description: Claude Code plugins published from the systemfsoftware monorepo

plugins.name: oxlint-guard
plugins.description: Lints every agent edit with oxlint and blocks edits that weaken the oxlint config

plugins.name: git-subtrees
plugins.description: Blocks unsafe git subtree invocations (URL fetch, missing --squash/-S, subtree push)

plugins.name: pnpm-guard
plugins.description: Blocks agent edits and commands that weaken pnpm's supply-chain posture (release-age quarantine, build grants, registries, auth lines)
